body: Tomas, useful ang hard rule, pero from a trend lens hindi pa sapat ang isang CAA warning para sabihing 'surging' ang recovery scams. Ang stronger signal would be repeated official alerts, rising consultation counts, or the same recovery-script appearing across channels over time. Until then: treat the tactic as verified and dangerous, but keep the frequency claim modest. Scammers already sell certainty; huwag nating gayahin sa statistics.
